$description: Generated from Ascendum Design System (snapshot 5lhRMZkLHZijqgdigjk3J1). Do not edit by hand.

gap.$description: Gap between accordion title and chevron.

padding-h.$description: Accordion header horizontal padding. Source used 26px.

padding-v.$description: Accordion header vertical padding. Source used 22px.

body-gap.$description: Gap between alert title and text. Source used 6px.

gap.$description: Gap between icon and body. Source used 14px.

body-gap.$description: Jira Annotation: gap inside the body.

body-padding-v.$description: Jira Annotation: top and bottom padding of the body. Follows the Overview Card body.

gap-header.$description: Jira Annotation: gap inside the header.

padding-badges-bottom.$description: Jira Annotation: padding under the badges.

padding-badges-top.$description: Jira Annotation: padding above the badges.

padding-bottom-header.$description: Jira Annotation: padding under the header.

padding-h.$description: Jira Annotation: left and right padding.

padding-v.$description: Jira Annotation: top and bottom padding.

dot.$description: Status dot inside a pill. Inherits the pill's text colour.

gap.$description: Gap between a pill's dot and its label.
Gap between breadcrumb item and separator.

padding-h.$description: Horizontal button padding. Reconciles Button.jsx (28px) and .btn (22px), they were the same button at desktop and mobile, never tokenised.

padding-v.$description: Button: top and bottom padding. 12 on mobile.

radius.$description: Checkbox corner. Source specifies 3px, tighter than radius/field (4px).

head-padding-h.$description: Code block header horizontal padding. Source used 18px.

min-height.$description: Combobox minimum height, matches the search bar.

token-height.$description: Selected token height. Source used 34px; rounded to 32.

max-width.$description: Empty state body text max width.

gap.$description: Gap between label, field and message.

body-gap-h.$description: Group cards: horizontal gap inside the body.

body-gap-v.$description: Group cards: vertical gap inside the body.

gap.$description: Group cards: gap between the header and the body.

padding-h.$description: Group cards: left and right padding.

padding-v.$description: Group cards: top and bottom padding.

textarea-min.$description: Minimum height for a multiline field, from textarea.field-input in components-fields.html.

gap.$description: Gap between label and trailing element.

padding-v.$description: Source used 11px; rounded to 12 for the 4px grid.

body-padding.$description: Modal body vertical padding. Source used 18px.

head-padding.$description: Modal header top padding. Source used 26px.

actions-gap.$description: Overview Card: gap between the actions.

body-padding.$description: Overview Card: padding of the body.

head-padding.$description: Overview Card: padding of the header.

padding-h.$description: Overview Card: left and right padding.

padding-v.$description: Overview Card: top and bottom padding.

height-sm.$description: Progress track height, small, the default.

gap.$description: Gap between search icon and input, default.

gap-compact.$description: Gap between search icon and input, compact.

gap.$description: Gap between select label and chevron.

padding-h.$description: Select horizontal padding. Source used 14px; rounded to 16 to hold the 4px grid.

padding-v.$description: Select vertical padding. Source used 10px; rounded to 12 to hold the 4px grid.

gap.$description: Gap between side nav groups. Source used 22px.

padding-v.$description: Side nav vertical padding. Source used 22px.

block.$description: Height of the skeleton block, a placeholder for an image or a chart.

circle.$description: Skeleton circle diameter, a placeholder for an avatar.

gap.$description: Gap between the label and the value.

count-gap.$description: Gap between tab label and count. Source used 6px; rounded to 8 to hold the 4px grid.

count-padding-h.$description: Tab: left and right padding of the count. 0 on mobile.

count-padding-v.$description: Tab: top and bottom padding of the count. 0 on mobile.

body-gap.$description: Toast: gap between the title and the meta line. 0 on mobile.

gap.$description: Gap between toast icon and body. Source used 14px.

inset-h.$description: Horizontal knob inset. 1.5px border + the source's 2px offset, CSS positions the knob from the padding edge, so the true offset from the outer edge is 3.5px.

inset-v.$description: Vertical knob inset. The knob is centred, so this only sets the minimum breathing room.

knob.$description: Toggle knob diameter, inset 2px from the track.

arrow-overlap.$description: Tooltip: how far the arrow overlaps the bubble. 0 on mobile.

field.$description: Form field border. Neither hairline (1px) nor button (2px), the field preview specifies 1.5px and it had no token.

focus.$description: Weight of the keyboard focus ring.

body.$description: Font size of Body/Default, Body/Default Semi-Bold.

body-lg.$description: Font size of Body/Large, Body/Large Bold.

body-sm.$description: Dense-UI text, tables, meta rows, chips. 43 hardcoded uses in the source CSS; legitimised as a role.

button.$description: 17px desktop / 16px mobile. The mobile value comes from .btn in extended-components.css.

caption.$description: Smallest supported size. Only 3 uses in source, weakest case in the scale, drop if it stays unused.

display.$description: Font size of Heading/Display. 42 on mobile.

h2.$description: Font size of Heading/H2. 32 on mobile.

h4.$description: Fills the gap between H3 (20) and H2 (40). The source used 22, 24 and 26 across empty states, accordions and modals, all drift around the same missing role.

stat.$description: Metric value. 44px desktop / 36px mobile. Sits between H2 (40) and Display (56); the source used 44 with -4% tracking, the tightest in the system.

columns.$description: Gap between the columns of the grid.

card.$description: Nested card corner. Concentric with radius/container: an inner corner should be the outer radius minus the inset, so 20 outer with a 4px inset gives 16. Use this for any card sitting inside a container, and radius/container for the outermost surface.

field.$description: Form fields only, the quiet middle ground.

none.$description: SIGNATURE, the button radius. Sharp corners against 20px cards is the brand fingerprint. Do not round.

surface.$description: Overlay and notification corner, menus, popovers, alerts, toasts. Between radius/field (4) and radius/container (20).

col-1.$description: Column width in a one-column layout.

col-2.$description: Width of one column in a two-column layout.

col-3.$description: Width of one column in a three-column layout.

col-4.$description: Width of one column in a four-column layout.

col-5.$description: Width of one column in a five-column layout.

col-6.$description: Width of one column in a six-column layout.

container.$description: Width of the page container. 264 on mobile.

control.$description: Checkbox box and radio ring. Fixed geometry, does not scale with breakpoint.

full-width.$description: Full width of the page. 360 on mobile.

icon-sm.$description: Small UI icon, for dense rows.

2xs.$description: Gap between related items inside a card. 12 on mobile.

3xs.$description: Tight pairs, such as a label and its field.

control-gap.$description: Gap between a control and its label. Sits between space/3xs (8) and space/2xs (16), the source uses 10px and it had no token.

lg.$description: Largest section padding. Non-linear jump from md, intentional.

md.$description: Gap between sections of a page. 48 on mobile.

sm.$description: Gap between blocks inside a section. 32 on mobile.

xs.$description: Padding inside a card. 24 on mobile.

blue.$description: Brand accent. Use sparingly and never for status. For surfaces use the soft tint.

blue-soft.$description: Soft tint of accent/blue. Background only; always with dark text on top.

purple.$description: Brand accent. Use sparingly and never for status. For surfaces use the soft tint.

purple-soft.$description: Soft tint of accent/purple. Background only; always with dark text on top.

red.$description: Brand accent. Use sparingly and never for status. For surfaces use the soft tint.

red-soft.$description: Soft tint of accent/red. Background only; always with dark text on top.

stone.$description: Brand accent. Use sparingly and never for status. For surfaces use the soft tint.

stone-soft.$description: Soft tint of accent/stone. Background only; always with dark text on top.

grey.$description: Muted text, captions, placeholders, blockquote rules.

midnight.$description: Brand anchor. Text, borders, dark sections.

milkyway.$description: Page background. Never pure white, pure white reads cheap.

careers-end.$description: End stop for the 135° Talent gradient.

digital-end.$description: End stop for the 135° Digital gradient.

process-solutions-end.$description: End stop for the 135° Mortgages gradient.

team-1.$description: Team gradient stop 1 of 4. Figma cannot store gradients as variables, these feed the paint styles.

200.$description: Hairline divider. 61 uses in source, the most-used unbound colour.

500.$description: Sits behind text/muted, icon/muted, text/inverted-muted. Bind the role, not this.

600.$description: Half-step pair with 650, deliberately kept distinct from #888888.

650.$description: Half-step pair with 600, deliberately kept distinct from #999999.

750.$description: Muted text on light surfaces. Closest grey to brand grey (#777777) that passes WCAG AA: 4.61 on page, 4.81 on subtle, 5.02 on surface.

800.$description: Half-step pair with 850, deliberately kept distinct from #444444.

850.$description: Half-step pair with 800, deliberately kept distinct from #555555.

925.$description: DERIVED, midpoint between neutral/950 (page) and neutral/900 (surface). Added because dark mode had no value between the two, leaving bg/subtle collapsed onto bg/surface.

error.$description: Functional feedback only. Distinct from dept/products #de4b54.

error-bg.$description: Sits behind feedback/error-bg. Bind the role, not this.

error-bg-dark.$description: DERIVED, status/error flattened at 20% over neutral/950. The source only ever authored light-mode tints. Provisional: adjust to taste, the semantic alias will follow.

error-on-dark.$description: Error text and icons on dark surfaces. status/error lightened until it passes AA (4.6) on page, surface and error-bg-dark.

info-bg.$description: Sits behind feedback/info-bg. Bind the role, not this.

info-bg-dark.$description: DERIVED, status/info flattened at 20% over neutral/950. The source only ever authored light-mode tints. Provisional: adjust to taste, the semantic alias will follow.

info-on-dark.$description: Info text and icons on dark surfaces. status/info lightened until it passes AA (4.6) on page, surface and info-bg-dark.

success-bg.$description: Sits behind feedback/success-bg. Bind the role, not this.

success-bg-dark.$description: DERIVED, status/success flattened at 20% over neutral/950. The source only ever authored light-mode tints. Provisional: adjust to taste, the semantic alias will follow.

success-on-dark.$description: Success text and icons on dark surfaces. status/success lightened until it passes AA (4.6) on page, surface and success-bg-dark.

warning-bg.$description: Sits behind feedback/warning-bg. Bind the role, not this.

warning-bg-dark.$description: DERIVED, status/warning flattened at 20% over neutral/950. The source only ever authored light-mode tints. Provisional: adjust to taste, the semantic alias will follow.

warning-on-dark.$description: Warning text and icons on dark surfaces. status/warning lightened until it passes AA (4.6) on page, surface and warning-bg-dark.

accent-blue.$description: Soft accent surface (avatars, tags). Same in light and dark. Pair with text/on-accent.

accent-purple.$description: Soft accent surface (avatars, tags). Same in light and dark. Pair with text/on-accent.

accent-red.$description: Soft accent surface (avatars, tags). Same in light and dark. Pair with text/on-accent.

accent-stone.$description: Soft accent surface (avatars, tags). Same in light and dark. Pair with text/on-accent.

hover.$description: Row and menu-item hover. Deliberately not bg/subtle, that darkens in dark mode, which is the wrong direction for a hover.

inverted.$description: BUG FIX vs source: --inverted-background was never redeclared in the dark block, so inverted sections rendered midnight-on-midnight. This genuinely inverts.

skeleton.$description: Skeleton placeholder fill. The source uses an animated shimmer gradient (#ececec > #f7f7f7 > #ececec). Figma cannot animate, and a gradient paint style cannot mode-switch, so this is the solid resting colour and the shimmer stays a code-side concern.

subtle.$description: Sits between page and surface. Dark value uses the derived neutral/925.

field.$description: Border of inputs and other fields.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring. The only outline that appears outside a control.

muted.$description: De-emphasised field border. Between border/default (hairline) and border/field (full contrast).

quote.$description: BUG FIX vs source: same undeclared --brand-mid-grey alias as text/placeholder.

fill.$description: Transparent by default, the outline button fills only on hover. Figma has no transparent keyword, so this is 0% alpha rather than an alias.

fill-hover.$description: Fill of the Solid button, and of Outline and Ghost on hover.

fill-hover-inverted.$description: For buttons sitting on an inverted (dark-in-light / light-in-dark) section. Distinct from the mode-following button/* tokens.

fill-solid-hover.$description: Solid button under the pointer. One step off the resting fill, so the hover is visible.

fill-solid-hover-inverted.$description: Solid inverted button under the pointer.

label.$description: Label of the Outline and Ghost buttons.

label-hover.$description: Label of the Solid button, and of the others on hover.

label-hover-inverted.$description: For buttons sitting on an inverted (dark-in-light / light-in-dark) section. Distinct from the mode-following button/* tokens.

label-inverted.$description: For buttons sitting on an inverted (dark-in-light / light-in-dark) section. Distinct from the mode-following button/* tokens.

stroke-inverted.$description: For buttons sitting on an inverted (dark-in-light / light-in-dark) section. Distinct from the mode-following button/* tokens.

error.$description: Error text, icons and borders. Meaning only, never decoration.

error-bg.$description: Dark value is derived (status flattened over the dark page colour), not authored in the source. Provisional.

info.$description: Info text, icons and borders. Meaning only, never decoration.

info-bg.$description: Dark value is derived (status flattened over the dark page colour), not authored in the source. Provisional.

success.$description: Success text, icons and borders. Meaning only, never decoration.

success-bg.$description: Dark value is derived (status flattened over the dark page colour), not authored in the source. Provisional.

warning.$description: Warning text, icons and borders. Meaning only, never decoration.

warning-bg.$description: Dark value is derived (status flattened over the dark page colour), not authored in the source. Provisional.

default.$description: Bind all 203 icon components to this. It is what collapses the 406 exported SVGs into 203 mode-aware components.

muted.$description: Secondary icons. Passes 3:1 on the page.

inverted-muted.$description: Secondary text on bg/inverted. Replaces text/inverted at reduced opacity. Contrast 8.9 in light mode, 4.6 in dark.

link.$description: Links. Same value as text/default today: an open question for the owner.

muted.$description: Secondary text. Passes AA on page, subtle and surface.

on-accent.$description: Dark text on a soft accent surface or a light gradient. Fixed in both modes because the surface under it does not switch.

placeholder.$description: BUG FIX vs source: --form-placeholder aliased --brand-mid-grey, which is never declared anywhere. Resolved to nothing.
